item.title: Photobook: from concept to object
item.description:
An archive is not a project. A book is.

Photos on a hard drive wait. A photobook decides: which ones make it, which don’t, in what order, with what voice. Making a book forces you to understand what your images are actually about — and to defend it on every page.

This workshop is for anyone who has images and wants to make the step. It doesn’t matter whether the project is a year of street photography, a neighbourhood, a family or a darkroom process. What matters is having a real body of work and the desire to turn it into an object.

item.title: Making a real photobook. From scratch.
item.description:
Having images is the starting point. Turning them into a book is a completely different decision. A photobook forces you to choose — which images go in, which do not, in what order, in whose voice — and every decision defines what the whole thing is about.

The new Photobook: from concept to object workshop is for those who want to take that step seriously. It is not a Photoshop course or a printing tutorial: it is complete guidance from the concept to the file ready for the printer.
